text.tspan: A room with several kinds of attendance
A relational map of particular presences, not a complete guest census.

A > B: return and refusal / A > C: chair and watch remain / A > D: attendance by her seat / A > E: repeated gesture / A > F: recipe becomes a file
Physical absence and continued attendance do not share one meaning; the licensed friend's return can be refused.
